# telnyx_terms_of_service_agreements (Data Source)

The Terms of Service agreements the account made.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.
- `product_type` (String) Telnyx product the Terms of Service apply to. One of `branded_calling`, `number_reputation`.

### Read-Only

- `terms_of_service_agreements` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--terms_of_service_agreements))

<a id="nestedatt--terms_of_service_agreements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `terms_of_service_agreements`

Read-Only:

- `agreed_at` (String) When you accepted this version of the terms.
- `created_at` (String) When this agreement record was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this recorded agreement.
- `product_type` (String) Telnyx product the Terms of Service apply to.
- `terms_version` (String) The version of the terms you accepted.
- `version` (String) Convenience alias of `terms_version`. Both keys are present on every response.
